The '''Jedi Battle Logs''' were [[Datafile/Legends|datafiles]] written by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who served in some of the fiercest battles of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], as a record of their internal struggles beyond fighting the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].
